base: local static preview of tracked guide documents
repository_state: uncommitted changes present at capture time
note: Guide document checks supporting the literal journey observations.
data_vintage: Guide prose is built from tracked sources; review dates are recorded editorial facts. Illustrated public records retain their capture date, source route, revision and data provenance in the matching site/media/guide article receipt. The search document is served from the local build and its results are not asserted by this release check.

captures.assertion: The front page carries a visible Guide entry in its primary navigation that links to the guide home.
The guide home orients a signed-out reader with the four reader-facing sections and links every article that is published.
The first tutorial loads directly with its type, review date, steps, action results, sources and a link back to the task.
The tutorial follows one notice to the duty behind it and its source law, and keeps a publication, a connection and a compliance finding apart.
The tutorial builds a two-step trail, shows that it travels in the address, and says an awardee is not an opportunity.
The how-to opens one connection receipt, says what it supports, and covers a connection that carries no source document of its own.
The how-to filters an agency to a day and is explicit that an undated record is not kept and that this is not a reconstruction of what the site knew.
The how-to keeps device storage, a recognized session, a downloaded file and a shared snapshot apart, and says what a share exposes and for how long.
The explanation loads on its own, keeps the stages of a contract, a rule and a land-use review apart, and distinguishes the four ways to take part.
The explanation names the three bases a connection can rest on and says why a real relationship can still be missing.
The explanation separates the kinds of date and the kinds of blank, and says an unknown is not a zero and a closed window is not an invitation.
The explanation gives each computed note a plain meaning and links the page that owns its exact rule instead of restating a threshold.
The glossary loads on its own and lays its terms out in tables, including the identifiers a reader meets on a record.
The controls reference says what each control leaves the reader with, keeps a preview apart from a subscription, and sends machine parameters to the API page.
The sources reference shows the inventory generated from the source registry and links the pages that own coverage and endpoints.
Find and narrow records loads directly with its section and type, its review date, its own content, a link back to the guide home, and the link that returns the reader to the product.
Follow a search and manage your updates loads directly with its section and type, its review date, its own content, a link back to the guide home, and the link that returns the reader to the product.
Follow a Community Board loads directly with its section and type, its review date, its own content, a link back to the guide home, and the link that returns the reader to the product.
Put dates in your calendar loads directly with its section and type, its review date, its own content, a link back to the guide home, and the link that returns the reader to the product.

Read a land-use project's next step and documents loads directly with its section and type, its review date, its own content, a link back to the guide home, and the link that returns the reader to the product.

Read a budget request and the answer to it loads directly with its section and type, its review date, its own content, a link back to the guide home, and the link that returns the reader to the product.
The product route the tutorial returns the reader to serves its document. Result content is assembled from live records and is not asserted here.
